messages:
incident-bot: Pager P1 - continuous-batching latency cliff in us-west-2 (high concurrency). Elevated 5xxs and request queueing. Runbook: cb-regression. https://incident.redwood/example :rotating_light:
maya: seeing 95th latency spike to 3.2s and burst of kv-eviction logs on cb-runtime-*(pods). Prefetch-rate doubled over last 10m. :eyes:
sam: confirmed. KV cache miss ratio jumped from 3% to 28% at 16:40UTC. Lots of small microbatches stacking. Might be prefetch misheuristic.
olivia: are we impacting hosted customers or just internal tests?
support-lead: several customers reporting higher latency for chat endpoints; two support tickets from tiered accounts (chat-prod orgs). No major data loss but UX broken.
kai: digging into metrics - continuous_batch.microbatch_size distribution shifted right, microbatch_wait_ms increased. There's also evidence of jitter causing batch amplification.
maya: initial mitigation: reduce continuous_batch.max_microbatch_size from 64 -> 8 on us-west-2 to force smaller tails. Preparing patch now.
sam: +1. Also disable prefetch for top-level route 'chat-stream' for 10m: set route.prefetch.enabled=false. That should stop kv churn.
maya: applying patch to canary pool (cb-canary-usw2-1) with rolling restart. Command: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/cb-runtime CONT_BATCH_MAX_MB=8 --record`
deploy-bot: Started rollout cb-runtime canary (deployment/cb-runtime) - revision 202 -> 203. Watch pods/cb-runtime-canary-*.
okay: typo in command, using config map patch instead: `kubectl -n inference patch cm cb-config -p '{"data":{"max_microbatch_size":"8"}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/cb-runtime`
sam: saw immediate drop in queueing on canary, latency 95th down from 3.2s -> 1.1s on canary within 45s. No 5xx observed on canary.
maya: expanding patch to 20% traffic (canary weight) for 5m then 50% if stable. Also temporarily set prefetch.timeout_ms=0 to disable prefetch.
support-lead: letting support know we're rolling a targeted config hotfix. ETA for 50% is ~8m. I'll update the customer tickets.
kai: capturing logs: `grep -i evict /var/log/cb-runtime/*.log | tail -n 200` shows correlated spikes with large microbatch sizes. Prefetch seemed to trigger recursive fills.
olivia: timeline note for handoff: if stable at 50% after 10m, plan to rollout global and follow up with revert plan in case of regression.
maya: after 10m at 20% - metrics stable, error rate down 60% on canary. Increasing to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 50% gate passed. Adjusting traffic weights.
sam: monitoring. No new customer 5xxes in last 7m. Throttling prefetch counts by half as an extra guard: `prefetch.max_concurrent=50 -> 25`.
night-oncall: I'm taking watch in 25m. Please leave handoff note and final state.
maya: handing off: current state - max_microbatch_size=8, prefetch disabled for chat-stream, global prefetch.max_concurrent reduced to 25, rollout at 50% and stable for 12m, customer impact decreased. Key next steps: continue monitoring 30m, if no regression roll to 100%, else revert to previous config and open postmortem.
support-lead: updated tickets: customers told mitigation in progress, offered timeline and credit if degraded further.
kai: capturing perf snapshot and saving to s3://redwood-telemetry/incidents/1758004321/cb-regression-telemetry.tar.gz
maya: creating short incident summary for ops channel and scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00PT. Will include root-cause hypothesis: prefetch heuristic + microbatch growth + jitter amplification leading to kv cache thrash and eviction storm.
sam: adding runbook note: add automated guard to prevent continuous_batch.max_microbatch_size > 16 under high-concurrency signals.
night-oncall: ack, I'll pick up and continue monitoring. If anything spikes I'll page on-call SRE. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by night-oncall. Duration so far: ~21m.
